newsitem.title: UK: Shire buys Austrian rights for Nivalin.
newsitem.headline: Shire buys Austrian rights for Nivalin.

text.p: Britain's Shire Pharmaceuticals Group Plc said on Tuesday that it has bought the worlwide manufacturing and supply rights for synthetic galantamine and marketing rights to Nivalin (galantamine) in Austria.
Shire said that it acquired the rights along with Janssen Pharmaceutica NV, a unit of Johnson & Johnson, and Shire's co-development and licensing partner for galantamine.
The partners are buying the galantamine rights to Austria and certain Eastern European countries from Waldheim Pharmazeutika.
Shire also bought the rights to the Nivalin trademark for one million dollars.
Galantamine has been used in Austria in the treatment of a variety of neurological and muscular disorders, including the treatment of Alzheimer's disease.
